name: Solar On Earth
old_description: A community solar program through Solar On Earth allows anyone (residential or commercial and regardless if you rent or own) to opt into a local community solar energy farm. The local solar farm allows you to take advantage of solar power without rooftop panels. You will help reduce emissions and lower your utility bill through solar credits.
about:
Solar On Earth operates from its headquarters in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, with a second office in Chadwick, Illinois. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available materials.

The firm administers community solar subscription programs that allow residential and commercial customers to access electricity generated by local solar farms without installing rooftop panels. Subscribers receive utility bill credits tied to their share of a farm’s output. The company manages enrollment, ongoing account support, and coordination with utility providers across more than a dozen states.

Solar On Earth serves homeowners, renters, and businesses in Massachusetts, New York, Maryland, Maine, Hawaii, Illinois, Minnesota, Colorado, Vermont, Delaware, New Jersey, Rhode Island, and New Hampshire. Customers include both residential and commercial accounts seeking to reduce emissions and lower electricity costs through state-authorized community solar programs.

The company emphasizes a guided enrollment process and continued support to help subscribers maintain savings, and it cites an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau as a mark of service quality.
